scope: Source audit of installed pinned baseline native ITL semantics; not a cross-engine latency comparison.
sglang: Tokenizer-manager updates after initial TTFT take elapsed interval divided by newly observed completion-token count. Histogram increments bucket weight by number of new tokens and sum by full elapsed interval. Thus a multi-token update contributes a repeated averaged interval, not separately timed token arrivals.
vllm: IterationStats update_from_output appends engine_core_timestamp minus prior last_token_ts for non-prefilling output updates. Logger observes these update intervals individually. It is engine-update timing, not client chunk arrival; multi-token/speculative output would require extra interpretation.
interpretation: Compare policies within the same pinned engine. Never pool native histograms across engines or equate them to request-level client TPOT proxies. Bucket boundaries provide bounds, not exact quantiles. Measurement window coverage and counter monotonicity must be verified separately.
